text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All of Symboli Rudolf's races have<n>been run. With
seven crowns to her<n>name, she has proven beyond
all<n>doubt that she is truly the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The weight hangs heavy, but she is<n>strong enough
to bear it. We both<n>celebrate the fulfillment of our
shared<n>dream.
